title: Clinical_BA_ADRD: analysis code for "Longitudinal biological aging and risk of dementia in a large prospective Swedish cohort"
description: R code for the analyses in the manuscript "Longitudinal biological aging and risk of dementia in a large prospective Swedish cohort": biological age (Klemera-Doubal Method and PhenoAge) from clinical biomarkers in the AMORIS cohort, Cox and Fine-Gray models for Alzheimer's disease and related dementias, and repeated-measures trajectory analyses. The underlying AMORIS data are restricted and are not included.
